review_candidates.title: Global Payroll and Human Resource Specialist
review_candidates.description: Global Payroll & HR Specialist Entry level · Full time · Remote, Malaysia ABOUT US Cosmos HR Consulting is a Payroll, HR, and Employer of Record company. We currently support employees across APAC, working through our own entities, and licensed payroll partners in each country. Our clients range from global HR platforms to engineering and sports-event companies. THE ROLE You will run the administrative engine of our monthly payroll cycle, and be the first point of contact for the day-to-day questions that come in from clients, employees and our in-country partners. This is a coordination role at heart. Our payroll cycle runs every month across APAC, and the work is making sure information and money move between the right people on time, accurately, with a clean paper trail. If that sounds satisfying rather than tedious, you will do well here. WHAT YOU WILL DO The monthly payroll cycle Send the monthly instruction reminders to clients on a fixed calendar, and follow up on whatever has not come back Pass payroll instructions to our in-country partners and track the reports and invoices returning from them Check partner payroll reports and invoices line by line against our register, and flag anything that does not reconcile Prepare payroll registers and supporting schedules for review Collect payslips from partners, file them correctly, and distribute them to clients and employees File proofs of payment and keep invoice and payment records current Onboarding and employee documents Send onboarding forms to new hires and follow up with missing documents until each file is complete Route employment contracts for signature and file the signed copies Track probation end dates, contract renewals and document expiry Keep employee records accurate and consistent across our master data and client systems Day-to-day support Answer routine questions from employees and clients on payslips, leave, benefits and statutory contributions Process insurance enrolments and retrieve documents from insurer portals Prepare employment letters, certificates of employment and verification letters from templates Coordinate between clients and partners so that questions get answered by the right party, quickly Records and systems Maintain trackers and registers in Google Sheets, Notion and Odoo Reconcile our records against clients' and partners', and clear the differences Keep our Google Drive and Notion filing tidy and to convention YOUR FIRST SIX MONTHS We are not going to hand you nine countries on day one. The plan is deliberate: Months 1 and 2 — shadow a full payroll cycle end to end. Take over filing, document chasing and payslip distribution. Months 3 and 4 — run the reminder and follow-up calendar yourself. Prepare payroll registers and invoices for review. Months 5 and 6 — own the administrative side of the cycle, with the team reviewing by exception rather than checking everything. Beyond that, the natural direction is deeper ownership of specific countries, and involvement in work-pass applications, benefits and client onboarding. Where you go depends on what you turn out to be good at. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Essential One to two years in HR administration, payroll, accounts, or another coordination-heavy support role A track record of hitting fixed deadlines without being reminded Genuine care with numbers — you notice when a total looks wrong, and you check rather than assume Clear, polite written English. You will be emailing partners across the countries and you need to be understood first time Confident in Google Sheets or Excel — filters, sorting, lookups, and not put off by a formula Willing to chase people politely and persistently until you have what you need Able to work independently from home, with a reliable internet connection and a quiet place to take calls Legally entitled to work in Malaysia Helpful, but we can teach it Familiarity with Malaysian statutory contributions — EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB Experience with an HRIS, or with Odoo or a similar accounting system Any exposure to regional or multi-country work Mandarin alongside English This role is probably not for you if You want the same predictable rhythm every day. Month-end is busy, and the middle of the month is the pressure point You would rather wait to be told than notice something is missing and go after it You are uncomfortable saying "I do not know" or "I think I made a mistake" quickly and plainly HOW WE WORK We are writing our procedures down as we go. You will be handed a written process for each area you take on, and you will be expected to improve it as you learn where it is wrong. Nobody here is precious about their documents. GROWING HERE Within a year you will have a breadth that is hard to get this early anywhere else. From there the path is owning countries end to end, then a specialism or helping run the team as it grows. We back that with a close support by the GM, paid HRDF-claimable training, and a salary review at six and twelve months based on what you have taken over rather than time served. We are small, so there is no formal career framework here — you grow by taking work on and running it well, which is faster than a ladder if that suits you. THE DETAILS Location — fully remote within Malaysia. Occasional in-person meetings in the Klang Valley. Hours — standard Malaysian business hours, aligned to Asia-Pacific time zones. Contract — full time and permanent, following a three-month probation. Salary — RM 3,000 to RM 4,200 per month, depending on experience. Reports to — GM, Cosmos HR Consulting Sdn. Bhd. Start — as soon as you are available. HOW TO APPLY Send your CV to eor@cosmoshr.co with the subject line "Global Payroll & HR Specialist". Instead of a cover letter, answer this in a short paragraph: Tell us about a time you had to chase someone repeatedly to hit a deadline. What did you do, and how did it end? We understand the frustration of cold applying and not being responded to. Rest assured, we read every application and reply to everyone, successful or not.

Detta ger ett ökat behov av stöd och support till olika typer av användare och vi söker därför en senior IT-tekniker för att stärka upp vår IT-support. IT-enheten i Ale kommun arbetar med service och stöd till kollegor i andra verksamheter i kommunen där de flesta arbetar direkt mot Aleborna. Allt enheten gör ska ge nytta för dessa kollegor och för kommuninvånarna. Vi är en liten enhet där alla har ett varierat arbete där det gäller att kunna se nyttan och helheten för våra användare. Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande där en medarbetare har ett huvuduppdrag men också bidrar inom ett flertal andra områden. Våra uppgifter omfattar allt från den digitala arbetsplatsen för kommunens elever och personal till att sköta drift och underhåll av nät och servrar. Enheten bidrar till kommunens utveckling av digitala verktyg och system genom att medverka eller driva utvecklingsprojekt tillsammans med verksamheten. Arbetsuppgifter Den person vi söker till denna befattning ingår i IT-enhetens supportgrupp. Gruppen arbetar med att tillhandahålla teknisk utrustning samt ge support på både den och våra basläggande kontorsprogramvaror. Detta sker via telefon, ärendehanteringssystem, Helpdesk samt support på plats hos kund vid behov. Utöver detta grunduppdrag ska denna befattning ansvara för bland annat: Telefoni, operatörstjänster och telefonväxel när det gäller support och förvaltning Support, omvärldsbevakning och strategi kring hårdvara som datorer, telefoner plattor och liknande Support på Office365 Hantering, administration, förvaltning och utveckling av vårt ärendehanteringssystem Kvalifikationer Du behöver ha minst 2-årig utbildning inom IT på gymnasienivå och det är meriterande om utbildningen är på eftergymnasial nivå. Du behöver även ha erfarenhet av att arbeta med IT-teknisk kundsupport det vill säga, goda kunskaper i att arbeta i en HelpDesk samt goda kunskaper i hanteringen av teknisk utrustning och ärendehanteringssystem. Övrigt För att klara uppdraget behöver du ha relevant utbildning, kunskaper och erfarenhet inom ditt område samt goda förmågor i tal och skrift på svenska. Vi ser att du ska kunna arbeta systematiskt i projektform och i samverkan med användare. Vår värdegrund bygger på att tillsammans tar vi ansvar och skapar förtroende. Vi är måna om att våra medarbetare i Ale mår bra och erbjuder där det är möjligt flexibel arbetstid, friskvårdsbidrag samt förmånliga kollektivavtal. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta i Ale kommun? Läs mer här: https://ale.se/om-kommunen/jobba-i-ale-kommun.html Tillsammans skapar vi möjligheter, här finns en plats för alla och vi har nära till varandra. Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du INTE söka via systemet utan kontakta rekryteringsansvarig för hantering av din ansökan. För att underlätta rekryteringsarbetet ber vi dig att bifoga relevanta intyg och betyg för tjänsten du söker samt vid eventuell intervju ha möjlighet att uppvisa giltig ID-handling. Vi har endast möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via Varbi. Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta i Ale kommun? Läs mer här: Jobba i Ale kommun | Ale kommun Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande. Vi använder e-rekrytering för att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsarbetet. Alla dina uppgifter sparas på ditt CV-konto och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter när du vill. Fyll därför i dina uppgifter så omsorgsfullt som möjligt för att ge en rättvisande bild av dig själv. Dina personuppgifter behandlas i Varbi under rekryteringsprocessen och i den utsträckning detta är nödvändigt för att uppfylla lagstiftningen. Ansökan raderas 24 månader efter avslutande av rekrytering. Om du har ett Varbi-konto kan du använda redigeringen av din profil för att radera, ladda upp och redigera information. Kontakta annars Ale kommun. Vi vill upplysa om att din ansökan är en offentlig handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen.

review_candidates.title: ICT Senior Service Desk Analyst - Herts
review_candidates.description: Hertfordshire Constabulary Police Staff Permanent Full Time ICT Headquarters, Huntingdon, Cambs , Headquarters, WGC, Herts A4 £32,613 37 A great opportunity has arisen to join a growing support team as an ICT Senior Service Desk Analyst within the BCH (Beds, Cambs & Herts) ICT Department. Join the exciting and dynamic world of policing and contribute towards making Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire a safer place. Based at Hertfordshire Constabulary HQ or Cambridgeshire Constabulary, you will play a key role within the ICT Operations Team, supporting the tri-force ICT estate and ensuring that vital business systems remain highly available to officers and staff. About The Role As a Senior Service Desk Analyst, you will provide first-line ICT support while also taking on additional responsibility for supporting and guiding a team of five analysts. You will act as an escalation point for more complex or non-standard issues, helping to drive service quality and improve first-time fix rates. You will use your technical knowledge and customer service skills to diagnose hardware, software and communication issues reported via phone or self-service. Where resolution is not possible at first contact, you will ensure incidents are accurately logged, fully documented, and escalated within agreed SLAs, maintaining clear communication with users throughout. You will also contribute to continuous improvement by maintaining knowledge base articles and coaching the development of colleagues across the Service Desk. Why Join BCH ICT? Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire Police form one of the largest and most established collaborations in the UK. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and forward-thinking ICT environment, with exposure to a diverse technology estate and opportunities to build leadership experience. Employee Benefits 25 days annual leave, rising to 29 after 5 years’ service (plus public holidays) Competitive Local Government Pension Scheme Access to on-site gym facilities at HQ locations Hybrid working arrangements Blue Light Card discounts Sports and social club membership Employee Assistance Programme Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Everyone at Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire takes personal responsibility to help create an inclusive workplace, where police officers and staff respect one another, feel valued for their differences and can be themselves. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments, wherever needed so everyone feels welcome and can flourish. We are working hard to continue to enhance and increase our diversity across the three forces, where communities are under-represented, including those from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic communities, people of all ages, abilities, faiths, religions and gender, LGBT communities and those from other disadvantaged or marginalised backgrounds, who share our values and wish to make a difference to the communities we serve. All applications will be treated on merit, based on the evidence provided in your application and your suitability for the role for which you have applied. We are a Disability Confident employer offering a guaranteed interview scheme for all candidates with a disability covered by the Equality Act 2010 who meet the minimum entry requirements. Should you require any reasonable adjustments for your application process, please contact the HR Recruitment Centre on 01438 757 777. Flexible Working BCH supports agile and flexible working wherever possible. All requests will be considered in line with operational requirements. Police Barred and Advisory lists Individuals placed on the Police Barred and Advisory lists will not be considered for employment by the police for a minimum of 5 years from the date of listing in the case of gross misconduct, or 3 years from the date of listing in the case of poor performance. Vetting and Safeguarding BCH are committed to safeguarding and operate safer recruitment processes, to ensure a police service that employees are proud to work for because they feel safe, valued and part of a happy and supportive work environment. All employees and volunteers therefore will be subject to background checks including vetting and references. Please be aware the Police Corporate Vetting Unit will undertake security vetting on successful candidates, their family and others that live at their home address, which will include financial checks. How To Apply If you are successful, you will be joining one of the most accomplished policing collaborations in the UK where our vision for the future of BCH Policing is exhibited daily across the full breadth of capabilities and functions we deliver. Please Submit Your CV Along With Evidence of your relevant skills and experience A 500-word statement demonstrating how you meet the minimum entry requirements For further information, please contact Jamie Read (BCH Operations, ICT Service Desk Team Leader) via Jamie.Read@cambs.police.uk Additional Advert Information Internal Applicants To apply for this role, internal applicants must have successfully completed their probationary period. If you qualify as an internal candidate within the advertising force, you may upload either your CV or the internal role summary form attached to this advert. Vetting Process Please note that, as part of the vetting process, the BCH Vetting Unit may need to contact your current line manager for a Supervisor Appraisal. This requirement aligns with the 2025 National Guidelines for Vetting (APP 6.5.18). Examples Of When This May Apply Include Transferring to another force Renewing vetting clearance Moving into a role requiring MV clearance (even if you currently hold MV clearance) Moving into or working in a role involving close contact with vulnerable individuals If any of the above apply to you, please expect your line manager to be contacted when you submit your vetting application. Redeployment and Redundancy This vacancy is open to employees at risk of redundancy and will remain available to redeployees until a final offer has been agreed and accepted. Redeployees at risk of redundancy will take priority over all other applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. If successful, redeployees will remain on their home force’s terms and conditions. Role Profile We recommend downloading and saving a copy of the role profile, as it will no longer be accessible once the advert closes. Commitment to Inclusion As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to be themselves. We provide workplace adjustments wherever needed so that all colleagues can thrive. If you have a disability and meet the minimum criteria for the role, you will be guaranteed an interview under the Offer an Interview Scheme.
